She Is Alone With Five Baby Dragons. Their mother died in the sky protecting her, and now Freya must keep five newborn white dragons alive in a frozen world that wants them dead. This is the full fantasy movie in 4K.

With Soren at her side and Auron, Skeld, Ember, Vael and Lyra riding on her sled, Freya crosses the snowy mountains in search of help to free her family. Nobody knows where white dragons came from. Only that they are good, they are magic, and the Dark Lord wants to corrupt them.

But the Ashborn are marching. Led by Kharvok and his priest Sareth Bonecaller, the orc army moves through the night to burn the next settlement of men before dawn. And they are hunting for the girl with the dragons.

She lost her village. She lost her dragon. She will not lose them.
